# Scope

> Scope tracks your VALORANT stats and turns them into a clear read on your game — rank progress, agent and map performance, badges, and a personal coach with Scope+.

Scope is a VALORANT stats tracker and companion app. It reads a player's match
history and rank data and surfaces it as rank progress, agent/map performance
breakdowns, head-to-head comparisons against other players, a regional
leaderboard, a badge/achievement system, and a daily-activity streak. Scope+
is an optional paid tier that adds a personalized weekly coaching
recommendation derived from the player's own performance metrics (Aim,
Consistency, Impact, Clutch), plus deeper breakdowns (round-type winrate,
clutch record, time-of-day patterns, teammate synergy) and data export.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://scopestats.com/) — the dashboard: rank, recent games, activity, badges, leaderboard, comparisons, and Scope+.
- [Legal](https://scopestats.com/legal.html) — terms of service and privacy policy.

## Notes for automated agents

- The dashboard shows a player's own data once logged in; logged-out visitors see a landing/marketing view instead.
- A player who has made their profile public is reachable at `https://scopestats.com/u/<riot-id-slug>`.
